senses.definition: a prince of Judah 2 Ch 17:14, 𝔊 Εδνα(α)ς.
a Manassite 1 Ch 12:21, prob. (reading ע׳, with Codd., for עַדְנַח; van d. H. עַדְנָח, 𝔊 Εδνα).—Vid. also עַדְנָא.
